open_research_findings.severity: MEDIUM (revised down from HIGH on evidence) — the MCC cross-run comparison is sound; the asymmetry is real but sits elsewhere
open_research_findings.finding: The four 55-map runs' Dawid-Skene fits may rest on DIFFERENT ground-truth references: the image run's fit implies a 4,745-point student ground truth, while the other three imply the 4,770-feature legacy layer.
open_research_findings.why_it_matters: Every cross-run D-S comparison in results/55maps-ds-summary-v2/report.md assumes a common reference. If the references differ, the comparisons are not like-for-like.
open_research_findings.state: PARTIALLY RESOLVED 2026-08-04 by the reference-layer census, which INVERTED the blind pass's split.
open_research_findings.history: Session 127 briefly asserted the CONTRARY — that all D-S aggregations consume the legacy layer — in a dated changelog. The blind pass refuted it and the claim was withdrawn in place rather than edited away.
open_research_findings.in_progress: A reference-layer census was commissioned 2026-08-04 to establish the fixed base, the correction-layer history, and the 4,770 account: reports/verification/c4-triage/student-gt-reference-census-2026-08-04.json. The PI's framing is that the underlying student GT is FIXED and only the curator-correction layer has moved.

census_result.fixed_base_confirmed: inputs/vectors/references/student-mounds-55maps.geojson = 4,770 features, ONE commit ever (301b51128, 2026-04-08), working-tree md5 byte-identical to that commit. The PI's framing that the underlying student GT is fixed is verified, not assumed.
census_result.reconciliation: 4,770 - 52 + 28 = 4,746 closes exactly: 26 merged-centroid replacements of student double-marks under 50 m (corroborated by gt-duplicate-decisions.csv, 26 merge / 70 keep_all) plus 2 curator additions.
census_result.the_inversion: The blind pass put IMAGE at 4,745 and the other three at 4,770. The census, reading cli_args.ground_truth directly, found the opposite locus: t0.3's outputs/.../evaluation/ consumed the UNREVIEWED 4,770 base while text-high, image and text-min all consumed the reviewed layer. Independently re-verified this session.
census_result.damage_bounded: All FOUR archived per-run MCC artefacts record ground_truth = student-mounds-55maps-reviewed.geojson. The MCC cross-run table in 55maps-mcc-v2-summary §§ 2-4 is therefore like-for-like, and the F1-versus-MCC rank-divergence finding does not rest on a reference mismatch.

open_research_findings.what_remains_open: Two things. (1) The t0.3 evaluation-layer difference is a NEW finding in its own right: any claim anchored to outputs/55maps-text-high-t0.3-generalisation/evaluation/ is on a different reference from its siblings, and t0.3 is the F1 leader in several places. (2) The blind pass reasoned from what the DAWID-SKENE FITS imply, not from evaluation metadata; those are different objects, so its claim is not strictly refuted by the census. Whether the D-S fits themselves share a reference is still unverified.
open_research_findings.method_note: Worth keeping: the blind pass corrected the repair, and the census corrected the blind pass. Neither layer was redundant, and the census only settled it because it read cli_args.ground_truth directly instead of inferring a reference from implied counts.

instrument_gaps.severity: MEDIUM — recurs on every future repair
instrument_gaps.gap: `git_blob` pins a whole DOCUMENT while batches cover RANGES. Any edit anywhere in a document invalidates the recorded blob for EVERY batch covering it, including batches whose own lines never moved.
instrument_gaps.evidence: After the 2026-08-04 withdrawal at ~line 577 (inside b074's range), b073 failed validation on blob mismatch despite all 86 of its spans re-verifying verbatim, with its highest referenced line at 323.
instrument_gaps.why_it_now_matters: Charter rule 14 (ruling 18) makes document repair routine, so this will fire constantly.
instrument_gaps.cheap_answer_used_once: Repoint the blob after a verbatim re-check of every span (bc21ff3be). Re-extracting untouched ranges would be waste.
proper_fix_options: Record a per-batch range hash alongside the document blob, so an untouched range validates independently.
Have the validator treat a blob mismatch as satisfied when every span in the file re-verifies against the current body.
Formalise repointing as a supported operation with a recorded reason, rather than a hand edit.

instrument_gaps.severity: HIGH (raised from MEDIUM on measurement) — the CI registry's stated purpose is paper CI citation
instrument_gaps.gap: Sidecar metadata disagrees with its artefact. `results/gold-standard-extended-buffer-sweep/evaluation.json` records 10000 iterations / BCa while its co-located `evaluation.metadata.json` still records 1000 / percentile — and results/ci-metadata-registry.md designates the SIDECAR as its authority.
instrument_gaps.why_it_matters: results/ci-metadata-registry.md exists to be the citable source for confidence-interval provenance in the paper. As it stands, a paper citing it would state the wrong bootstrap method (percentile rather than BCa) and the wrong iteration count (1000 rather than 10000) for these runs, and would point readers at several artefacts that are no longer where it says they are. This is the same defect P4 found in 55maps-mcc-v2-summary, one layer down: there the Methods prose was stale, here the registry that Methods prose is supposed to defer to is stale too.
instrument_gaps.state: MEASURED 2026-08-04. Worse than the sidecars alone.
instrument_gaps.next_step: Refresh the registry rows to the artefacts, repoint the archived paths, and either regenerate the surviving sidecars or retire them — a sidecar that no migration updates is a trap, not a record. Decide whether sidecars remain the registry's nominated authority at all.

measurement.sidecars: 7 of 7 evaluation.metadata.json sidecars disagree with their co-located evaluation.json — 100%. Every sidecar records 1000 iterations and no method; every artefact records 10000 and BCa.
measurement.mechanism: The sidecars were created at ad023fc3b (2026-04-21, '48 .metadata.json sidecars') and frozen there. The N=10K upgrade (580f498b6), the 55-map BCa migration (0699769c5) and the gold-standard BCa migration (85f115015) all rewrote evaluation.json and none touched a sidecar.
measurement.attrition: Of that commit's 48 sidecars only 7 evaluation.metadata.json files survive today; the rest were moved or removed without the registry following.
measurement.registry_rows_bootstrap: All 4 registry rows naming a readable artefact disagree with it on bootstrap method — the registry says 'bootstrap percentile', the artefacts say BCa; where N is legible the registry says 1000 against 10000.
measurement.registry_rows_paths: Of 70 single-path registry rows, 59 resolve and about 9 name artefacts that no longer exist (excluding two brace-glob notation cells). Several — results/55maps-cleaned-gt-evaluation/{image,text-high,text-min}/evaluation.json and results/55maps-image-generalisation/human-reviewed-corrected/corrected-f1-human-reviewed.json — were archived by da2cf355f, the SAME archival that produced W7-D1.

instrument_gaps.note_on_wave7_rows: Blind pass P4 already classed the four registry bootstrap rows (087#2[2], 087#3[2], 087#4[2], 087#5[1]) as 'genuinely stale-not-wrong' snapshot divergence. That verdict is right about the rows in isolation; this measurement is about the registry's fitness for the purpose it declares.

instrument_gaps.gap: The batch plan has no builder script — it was hand-built in S122 — so its `spans` figures cannot be regenerated. Units re-ranged in Session 127 carry density-scaled ESTIMATES flagged by a `spans_basis` field.
instrument_gaps.note: Do not compare estimated spans against original survey figures.

ground_truth_layers.why_this_was_missed: The session's census established three layers and stopped, because 4,770 -> 4,746 accounts arithmetically without the fourth. The PI's question — 'did I really find so few additional mounds? I thought I'd found hundreds' — is what surfaced it. A net decrease in the student layer is compatible with hundreds of discoveries living elsewhere, and the arithmetic closing exactly made the gap invisible.
ground_truth_layers.standing_caution: Any document citing a student-GT count near a claim about review effort must say WHICH layer it means. '4,746' read as 'all the ground truth' makes the review look vanishingly small.
